name: vocdoni-ui-style
description: Build UIs with Vocdoni's look and feel and UX flows, in its two visual modes: editorial (vocdoni.io: cream surfaces, warm ink, Fraunces serif headings, green accent, yellow eyebrow dot) and product (vocdoni-app: white, Inter at light weights, monochrome or white-label accent). Ships design tokens for Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, Chakra UI v3 and plain CSS, React components, logo files, reference screenshots, runnable HTML examples (landing page, voting flow, dashboard, sign-in, vote builder, transactional email), worked React recipes, step-by-step UX flows for voting, vote building, onboarding and member management, specs for docs sites and result PDFs, copy rules and a brand style checker.
